facts.fact: 清晨一名仆人来传话，说 Lord Xaniko 要见 Vedra 和 Daley 两个。
facts.anchor: Lord Xaniko has asked for you two

facts.fact: Vedra 在他被抬进 Threadbare Hall 的卧房后睡了一整段时间，被叫醒时慌忙起身。
facts.anchor: had slept deeply through the hours since

facts.fact: Xaniko 要她把这面龙鳞镜留在 Threadbare Hall，说她学得更多之前自己带着不安全。
facts.anchor: a dragonscale mirror is not a safe thing

facts.fact: 女管家只肯说这宅子「是他的地方」，再多她也不知道，并说主人康复要时间。
facts.anchor: I cannot tell you more because I do not know more

facts.fact: 家庭教师 Rumon 神父说王子和他要回 Cashelrigg，扮装搭一位船长的船走。
facts.anchor: Prince Ewain and I are leaving

facts.fact: Scaeth 拒不让母亲 Bellicent 与他同骑，要她在队伍里另找位置。
facts.anchor: under no circumstances ride with me

facts.fact: Flann 说两个孩子当然要跟他们走，眼下先去 High Oak Camp。
facts.anchor: they must go with us, of course

facts.fact: Mearna 抱住 Vedra，说做 Crows 不是小荣誉。
facts.anchor: that is no small honor, dear child
